skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 3 consecutive hits, dealing 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own [Instant DMG Hit Rate] and [Specialized Hit Rate] by 50%. Ignores 30% of the target’s [Evasion], [Specialized Evasion], and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Enters the [Berserk] state with 100% ATK. Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. Deals a 3-hit combo to all enemies in a row, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 3900% ATK.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own [Instant DMG Hit Rate] and [Specialized Hit Rate] by 70%. Ignores 50% of the target’s [Evasion], [Specialized Evasion], and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Enters the [Berserk] state with 130% ATK. Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. Deals a 3-hit combo to all enemies in a row, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 5400% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Grants self 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Reduces the number of revivals from [Regroup] and [Revenge] by 3. Dispels enemies’ [Specialized Counter DMG] effects and grants self and allies in the same column immunity to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Grants self 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Reduces the number of revivals from [Regroup] and [Revenge] by 5. Dispels enemies’ [Specialized Counter DMG] effects and grants self and allies in the same column immunity to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Grants self 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Reduces the number of revivals from [Regroup] and [Revenge] by 7. Dispels enemies’ [Specialized Counter DMG] effects and grants self and allies in the same column immunity to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 2 charges of [Momentum Return]. At the start of battle, gains 30% [Suppression DMG Reduction]. [Momentum Return]: When all allies are defeated, the unit returns to the battlefield with 110% HP. Any excess HP is converted into additional Max HP. [Suppression DMG Reduction]: Reduces DMG taken by 30%. If the unit’s ATK is higher than the target’s, the DMG reduction increases to 150%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 3 charges of [Momentum Return]. At the start of battle, gains 40% [Suppression DMG Reduction]. [Momentum Return]: When all allies are defeated, the unit returns to the battlefield with 200% HP. Any excess HP is converted into additional Max HP. [Suppression DMG Reduction]: Reduces DMG taken by 40%. If the unit’s ATK is higher than the target’s, the DMG reduction increases to 170%.
